dockerfile
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS provides a modern and stable user space.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package installations to prevent prompts.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures that MPI communication defaults to the TCP network fabric,
# which is compatible with container networking, and avoids issues with
# shared-memory transports (vader) or high-performance interconnects (openib)
# that are typically not available in standard cloud container environments.
# Also, allow oversubscription by default, which is common in CI/CD or development.
# Note: The user will still need to add `--allow-run-as-root` to the mpirun command.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1

# Combine installation, build, and cleanup into a single RUN layer.
# This minimizes the final image size by removing build dependencies and caches.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    cmake \
    build-essential \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libfftw3-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    \
    # Clone the latest stable version of LAMMPS for a production-ready build.
    git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /opt/lammps-src && \
    cd /opt/lammps-src && \
    \
    # Configure and build LAMMPS from source using CMake.
    # We enable the required REAXFF package and ensure MPI support is built.
    mkdir build && \
    cd build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
      -D BUILD_MPI=on \
      -D PKG_REAXFF=on \
      -D PKG_KSPACE=on && \
    \
    # Compile using all available processor cores for a faster build.
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    \
    # Copy the main LAMMPS executable to a standard location on the system PATH.
    # This makes 'lmp' directly available to users and scripts.
    cp lmp /usr/local/bin/ && \
    \
    # Set up the working directory and populate it with example files.
    mkdir -p /app && \
    cp /opt/lammps-src/examples/reaxff/HNS/* /app/ && \
    \
    # Clean up to reduce final image size.
    # Remove the source code and build-time dependencies that are not needed at runtime.
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/lammps-src && \
    apt-get purge -y --auto-remove git cmake build-essential libopenmpi-dev libfftw3-dev && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set the default working directory for the container.
WORKDIR /app

# The final image is now built with the 'lmp' executable on the PATH.
# Users can run the application with a command such as:
# mpirun -np <num_procs> --allow-run-as-root lmp -in <input_script>

# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS provides a modern and stable user space.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package installations to prevent prompts.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures that MPI communication defaults to the TCP network fabric,
# which is compatible with container networking, and avoids issues with
# shared-memory transports (vader) or high-performance interconnects (openib)
# that are typically not available in standard cloud container environments.
# Also, allow oversubscription by default, which is common in CI/CD or development.
# Note: The user will still need to add `--allow-run-as-root` to the mpirun command.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1

# Combine installation, build, and cleanup into a single RUN layer.
# This minimizes the final image size by removing build dependencies and caches.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    cmake \
    build-essential \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libfftw3-dev \
    libgomp1 \
    # FIX: Install Python 3, which is a required dependency for the LAMMPS CMake build process.
    python3 && \
    \
    # FIX: Clone the latest development branch by omitting the '-b stable' flag.
    git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /opt/lammps-src && \
    cd /opt/lammps-src && \
    \
    # Configure and build LAMMPS from source using CMake.
    # We enable the required REAXFF package and ensure MPI support is built.
    mkdir build && \
    cd build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
      -D BUILD_MPI=on \
      -D PKG_REAXFF=on \
      -D PKG_KSPACE=on && \
    \
    # Compile using all available processor cores for a faster build.
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    \
    # Copy the main LAMMPS executable to a standard location on the system PATH.
    # This makes 'lmp' directly available to users and scripts.
    cp lmp /usr/local/bin/ && \
    \
    # Set up the working directory and populate it with example files.
    mkdir -p /app && \
    cp /opt/lammps-src/examples/reaxff/HNS/* /app/ && \
    \
    # Clean up to reduce final image size.
    # Remove the source code and build-time dependencies that are not needed at runtime.
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/lammps-src && \
    # FIX: Add python3 to the purge list to remove it from the final image.
    apt-get purge -y --auto-remove git cmake build-essential libopenmpi-dev libfftw3-dev python3 && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set the default working directory for the container.
WORKDIR /app

# The final image is now built with the 'lmp' executable on the PATH.
# Users can run the application with a command such as:
# mpirun -np <num_procs> --allow-run-as-root lmp -in <input_script>

Assets for minicluster Agent
flux-minicluster-manifest
# This MiniCluster manifest is for deploying a LAMMPS HPC application
# using the Flux Operator on a Kubernetes cluster.
# It has been corrected to run on a specific ARM-based AWS instance type.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  # Deployment will be in the default namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node as requested.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster.
  tasks: 64
  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true
  # Pod cleanup policy. Pods will not be deleted after the job completes.
  cleanup: false
  # Flux-specific configuration.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for the Flux broker, required for ARM nodes.
    arch: arm
    # Fix: Specify the correct ARM-compatible image for the flux-view init container.
    # The previous attempt failed because the default image tag was not found for the ARM architecture.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  # Pod-specific settings to target specific hardware.
  pod:
    # Ensures the MiniCluster pods are scheduled on specific AWS Graviton instances.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "hpc7g.16xlarge"
  # Defines the container that will run the application.
  containers:
    - # The command to be executed by Flux, using a 16x16x16 grid.
      command: "lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite"
      # The main application container image.
      image: "ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax"
      # This container runs the main command; it is not the launcher.
      launcher: false

# This MiniCluster manifest is for deploying a LAMMPS HPC application
# using the Flux Operator on a Kubernetes cluster.
# It has been corrected to install a missing runtime dependency at launch.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  # Deployment will be in the default namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node as requested.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster.
  tasks: 64
  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true
  # Pod cleanup policy. Pods will not be deleted after the job completes.
  cleanup: false
  # Flux-specific configuration.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for the Flux broker, required for ARM nodes.
    arch: arm
    # Specify the correct ARM-compatible image for the flux-view init container.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  # Pod-specific settings to target specific hardware.
  pod:
    # Ensures the MiniCluster pods are scheduled on specific AWS Graviton instances.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "hpc7g.16xlarge"
  # Defines the container that will run the application.
  containers:
    - # The command to be executed by Flux, using a 16x16x16 grid.
      command: "lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite"
      # The main application container image.
      image: "ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax"
      # This container runs the main command; it is not the launcher.
      launcher: false
      # Fix: The application container is missing the libfftw3.so.3 shared library.
      # This pre-run command installs the necessary package at runtime to resolve the dependency issue.
      commands:
        pre: apt-get update && apt-get install -y libfftw3

# This MiniCluster manifest is for deploying a LAMMPS HPC application
# using the Flux Operator on a Kubernetes cluster.

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  # Deployment will be in the default namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node as requested.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster.
  tasks: 64
  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true
  # Pod cleanup policy. Pods will not be deleted after the job completes.
  cleanup: false
  # Flux-specific configuration.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for the Flux broker, required for ARM nodes.
    arch: arm
    # Specify the correct ARM-compatible image for the flux-view init container.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  # Pod-specific settings to target specific hardware.
  pod:
    # Ensures the MiniCluster pods are scheduled on specific AWS Graviton instances.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "hpc7g.16xlarge"
  # Defines the container that will run the application.
  containers:
    - # The command to be executed by Flux, using a 16x16x16 grid.
      command: "lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite"
      # The main application container image.
      image: "ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax"
      # This container runs the main command; it is not the launcher.
      launcher: false
      # Fix: Corrected the package name for the FFTW3 runtime library.
      # The previous attempt failed with "E: Unable to locate package libfftw3".
      # The correct package name in this container's OS is 'libfftw3-3'.
      commands:
        pre: apt-get update && apt-get install -y libfftw3-3

# This MiniCluster manifest is for deploying a LAMMPS HPC application
# using the Flux Operator on a Kubernetes cluster.
# It has been corrected to install a missing runtime dependency at launch.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  # Deployment will be in the default namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node as requested.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI tasks, matching the vCPU count of the new instance.
  tasks: 48
  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true
  # Pod cleanup policy. Pods will not be deleted after the job completes.
  cleanup: false
  # Pod-specific settings to target specific hardware.
  pod:
    # Ensures the MiniCluster pods are scheduled on a specific AWS x86 instance.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "c7a.12xlarge"
  # Defines the container that will run the application.
  containers:
    - # The command to be executed by Flux, using a 16x16x16 grid.
      command: "lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite"
      # The main application container image.
      image: "ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax"
      # This container runs the main command; it is not the launcher.
      launcher: false
      # Fix: The application container is missing the libfftw3.so.3 shared library.
      # This pre-run command installs the necessary package at runtime to resolve the dependency issue.
      commands:
        pre: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libfftw3-3
